resources.string: Colour themes, like Spicetify: install one, pick its colour scheme
The app\'s own colours (and your accent colour)
The accent, page, card and text colours follow your wallpaper, every time it changes. They go over the theme you pick; an extension\'s look still goes over them.
Set a wallpaper (Settings, Wallpaper) and the colours follow it.
An https address of a theme file

A theme sets the accent, page, card and text colours, and can set the text size and hide parts of the app. An extension\'s look applies over it. Pages stay dark; the black background setting still wins, and a wallpaper still shows through. Installed themes are plain files: nothing in them runs.
